name: Can I install a bathroom fixture myself, or do I really need a plumber?

mainEntity.name: Can I install a bathroom fixture myself, or do I really need a plumber?

acceptedAnswer.text: You usually do if the fixture involves water lines, drainage, wall-mounted parts, or anything that must be sealed tightly against leaks. Simple swaps can look easy, but a bad connection can cause hidden water damage, so professional installation is the safer choice for most bathroom fixtures.
acceptedAnswer.description: If it’s a simple like-for-like swap, DIY may be possible. For toilets, sinks, showers, tubs, or anything involving supply lines and seals, professional installation is usually safer to avoid leaks and damage.
